note: Small private RV park in the trees off Range Road 424, about 4 km from Cold Lake's municipal beach and 1 km from the regional airport. Guests can pick from the flower and organic vegetable garden, and there is a 4-acre area for practising golf shots. The park pitches itself to working crews as well as retired summer visitors. --Claude
